seoTitle: Capital Row: Report a dead deal
seoDescription: Did your deal blow up? Tell Capital Row what happened, confidentially. We publish nothing that identifies you, the buyer or the business.

items.text:
Report a dead deal.
Tell us what happened, confidentially.

Every report adds to Capital Row’s record of why deals fail: what was found, at what stage, by which kind of buyer, and what it cost. Each one is read by a person and coded by deterministic AI, the same way every time, so the patterns hold. We use them to show owners what a buyer is likely to raise before the next letter of intent, yours included.
Read by a person at Capital Row and never passed to a buyer, a broker or anyone else. We publish nothing that identifies you, the buyer or the business.
Twenty minutes with our team: what a buyer is likely to raise next time, and what to fix first.
Our dead deal findings by sector, sent to you before they are published.
About two minutes. Only what went wrong and an email address are required. Confidential, and never shared without your express written permission.
Confidential. Nothing you write here is shared or published without your express written permission. No names are requested, and a personal email address is fine.
Who advised you on the sale
What went wrong. Choose all that apply.
The earnings were not what was presented
A license, contract or compliance finding
Dependence on the owner or a key person
Records or systems could not support the numbers
I walked away; the business was not ready
Tell us what happened. Please leave out names.
Was the price or structure changed before it ended
What had been prepared before going to market
Was there a quality of earnings report before the deal?
When, and who prepared it, optional
Contracts needing consent when ownership changes
What you would do differently. Please leave out names.
Email. A personal address is fine.
I agree to receive text messages from Capital Row LLC at the mobile number above, such as market updates and event invitations. Consent is not a condition of any engagement.
Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Privacy Policy and SMS Terms.
You may contact me about this report, and to set up my debrief.
You may share what I describe here anonymously in Capital Row’s published work, with every identifying detail removed.
Your report goes directly to Capital Row and is kept confidential. A name is optional, and a personal email address is fine.
Thank you. If you ticked the box to be contacted, we will write from team@thecapitalrow.com within one business day to set up your debrief.
Reserve your seat at the owner session
Wednesday January 20. What a buyer will find in your 2026 numbers, and how to find it first.
